init.title: Polling options
init.description: Common status and preferences are polled every 10–300 seconds. Diagnostics are fetched at most every 300 seconds.

whole_temperature_required.message: Target temperature must be a whole number of degrees Celsius.

final_cleaning.message: The stove is finishing its cleaning cycle. Turn it on again after it switches off.

unknown_power_state.message: The stove reported an unknown power state ({state}). The command was not sent.

power_change_pending.message: The stove has not confirmed the previous power command yet. Try again once it reports the new state.

standby.message: The stove is in standby. Use the stove controls to switch it on or off.

alarm.message: The stove reports an alarm. Clear it on the stove before using power commands.

power_unacknowledged.message: The stove did not answer the power command. It may still act on it; its power state is being checked.
